Add (1) a FastAPI middleware dependency for token-bucket rate limiting keyed by tenant + route class, (2) Content-Length / upload size guards via existing request-validation middleware, (3) tenant-isolation expansion by tightening model_strategy.py query scoping and adding tenant-scoped filters to the event bus, (4) event streaming via SSE first (Starlette EventSourceResponse) reusing core/event_bus.py subscriptions; WebSocket/AG-UI as optional stretch behind a feature flag.
